page.text:
# Matthew Avery for Pinole City Council
Get Involved
###### For Pinole
# A Steadfast Voice for Pinole
I bring 28 years of public service, Old Town roots, and a practical commitment to represent the citizens. No personal ambitions, no political agendas.
Get Involved
Meet Matt
Priorities
Focused on What Matters
#### Safety
Public safety is the government’s primary responsibility and our City cannot thrive without safe neighborhoods.
Learn More
#### Infrastructure
Our City’s future depends on the foundations we build and rebuild today.
Learn More
#### Fiscal Stability
A thriving tomorrow is based on a balanced and sustainable budget where expenses are in line with revenue.
Learn More
###### Local Roots
## Serving the City We Call Home
As a longtime Old Town homeowner, husband, father, and grandfather, I understand what makes Pinole special.
After working for the CIty for nearly three decades, I am will bring experience, integrity, and a neighbor-first perspective to City Council.
About Matt
## Stay Connected
Sign up for campaign updates, local news, and ways to support Matt Avery for Pinole City Council.

page.title: Matthew Avery for Pinole City Council – Matt Avery is running for Pinole City Council, bringing 28 years with the Pinole Police Department, extensive community service, and family foundations in Old Town to serve local residents.
